headline: A rotated tetrahedral tight-frame architecture with 4K possible macroscopic directions, even dense on S2, remains asymptotically capped by 3sqrt(2) when every physical cap-one source is an independent unit-uniform convolution with arbitrary independent rough additive noise. The noise needs no moments, tightness, or limiting law.
partner_applied: Latest compatible account03/B17 theorem QFORM-GAUSSIAN-FULLTARGET-COMPARATOR-v1 at math-open-problems@ea855178c7771925095c4517c830888c9a8938ea is applied uniformly to every deterministic active shift z of N(0,I/12), giving the 3sqrt(2) Gaussian ceiling.
required_source_applied: Pinned math-open-problems@e5f71d79eff325201dd0274053d20268ce65b837 Theorem F is applied conditionally on arbitrary rough noise to the actual finite physical eigenframe; Gram I3, leverage 3/(4K)<=1/2, zero residual and the allowed linear term give the shift-uniform envelope |Phi(t)|<=min(1,(4pi)^(3/2)|t|^-3/2), exact L1 mass 24pi.
quantitative_result: If epsilon_K=sup_R ||g_K-N(0,I/12)||_1, then epsilon_K->0 and ||p_{X^T A_K X}||_infinity <=3sqrt(2)+(3/pi)[(4pi)^(3/2)+6^(3/2)]^(2/3) epsilon_K^(1/3), uniformly over rotations, all 3x3 B_K with spectral floor one, and all independent additive-noise laws.
next_step: Stress cap-one sources without an independent unit-uniform convolution carrier, or jump/carrier dependence / extra active spectrum that changes the diffuse carrier shape rather than producing a conditionable location shift.
